county_cities.value: Charleston County: Charleston (county seat; metro article also lists Berkeley), Mount Pleasant, Hollywood, Kiawah Island, Folly Island (City of Folly Beach), Edisto Island (mostly; unincorporated, southern tip in Colleton). North Charleston: spans Berkeley, Charleston and Dorchester counties. Summerville: mostly Dorchester, small parts in Berkeley and Charleston. Berkeley County: Goose Creek, Hanahan, Moncks Corner (county seat). Colleton County: Walterboro (also the southern tip of Edisto Island; Edisto Beach is a separate Colleton town). Metro area = Berkeley, Charleston, Dorchester counties.

local_context.value: Charleston metropolitan area: Berkeley, Charleston and Dorchester counties; 799,636 residents in the 2020 census. Humid subtropical climate (average annual relative humidity about 72.7%); "Hurricanes are a major threat to the area during the summer and early fall"; Hurricane Hugo struck as a Category 4 on September 21, 1989. 65+ share, 2020 census: Charleston 15.9%, North Charleston 11.8%, Mount Pleasant 18.0%.
